text:
Ashley: Heads-up — ran a focused autotune sweep on SM101 (driver 535.54) this morning. Selector is picking the generic_matmul path for seqlen=128 but microbench shows tensorcore_compact is faster for bf16 and fp8. Putting raw notes here.

Pranav: Can you paste the microbench numbers so we can see the gap?

Ashley: Sure — pasted output from a quick microbench run:

```
./microbench --arch sm101 --dtype bf16 --seqlen 128
kernel: generic_matmul  p50: 6.2ms  p90: 7.0ms
kernel: tensorcore_compact p50: 4.4ms  p90: 5.1ms

./microbench --arch sm101 --dtype fp8 --seqlen 128
kernel: generic_matmul  p50: 8.9ms  p90: 10.2ms
kernel: tensorcore_compact p50: 4.2ms  p90: 4.9ms
```

Marco: Whoa — ~1.4x for bf16 and ~2.1x for fp8. That magnitude should be enough to bias the cost model. Any idea why autotune picked generic?

Ashley: Two hints from logs: autotune run used the device probe feature_mask 0x2 (tensorcore present) but the tc path gate includes a 'supports_wmma' check that returned false on our probe due to driver returning incomplete capability bits. Also observed extra memcpy on the KV-cache fastpath for small seqlen (<256) which increases end-to-end latency and may hide kernel gains.

Pranav: Hmm — our capability table maps by SM major ranges; I suspect SM101 isn't included in the mapping so we fallback to conservative heuristics. Also there was a known driver quirk around fp8 on 535.* that CI flagged last week.

CI-bot: CI: perf/regressions/job-4202 detected p99 latency up by 25% for compile-sm101-tc-flavor on seqlen=128. See https://ci.internal/perf/4202

Ashley: Repro script I used:

```
python reproduce.py --model gpt-small --seqlen 128 --sm=101 --dtype fp8
# observe selected kernel: generic_matmul
# run microbench binary to compare
```

Marco: Action items I propose: 1) Update device probe to explicitly map SM101 to tensorcore-capable family, 2) Add a quick microbench step in the probe to sanity-check kernel latencies at seqlen 128/256, 3) Modify autotune cost model to prefer tensorcore_compact when microbench shows <0.85 * generic latency, 4) Audit KV-cache memcpy path so it doesn't negate kernel wins for small sequences.

Pranav: I'll take device probe and add the SM101 alias and the microbench hook. Also will add a per-arch seqlen threshold override for the KV prefetch path.

Ashley: :thumbsup: I'll open the autotune PR updating the cost model weights and weave in a regression test (nightly-only) that asserts kernel choice for SM101 seqlen=128/bf16 and fp8. Tagging @sre for rollout guard.

DevOps-Bot: Preview deployment created: rts/autotune/PR-1171 -> staging (expires in 7 days)

Marco: Also let's add a small perf harness job that runs on nightly infra (not every CI) to avoid flakiness but catch regressions early.

Ashley: Good call. I'll follow up with numbers after PR lands and the probe changes are deployed. Thanks all.
